summary: AIR Global PLC furnished a Form 6-K containing its first-half 2026 results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The Dubai-based flavored shisha molasses maker, listed on Nasdaq since May 18, 2026, reported revenue up 3.7% to $206.9 million, adjusted EBITDA flat at $71.7 million, and a net loss of $81.8 million after Strait of Hormuz disruptions cut shipment volumes. Interim financials, a shareholder letter, and a results presentation were attached. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms were disclosed.
